findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.citation_text: 5-205.11  (Pf) Upon arrival for the inspection, the hand sink was blocked by a tub. The tub was moved during the inspection. No items can be placed inside the hand sink. The hand sink should only be used for hand washing only.

findings.title: Sewage and waste water disposed properly
findings.comment: 750-1050 Observed a bucket of waste water in the back room. Discarded down the toilet during the inspection. Facility does not have a mop sink. There is an extra stool in the backroom used for mop water disposal.  All water containing sewage shall be disposed of  properly either by a public sewage system or an approved private disposal system which is constructed and operated in conformance with applicable State and local laws, ordinances and regulations.

findings.title: Hand washing sinks installed, located, accessible
findings.comment: 750-1110(a) The bar only has a triple sink available. Handwashing sink is located across the room in the personal kitchen. A supply of soap and papertoweling was provided for one of the sinks. The facility has a preponderance of bottle service. Dishes may be washed once or twice throughout the night. The middle sink will be designated as a handsink and the sink will be washed between uses.   Toilet facilities for employees shall be provided and installed according to law, shall be conveniently located and shall be accessible to employees at all times.

findings.title: Restrooms with self-closing doors, fixtures operate properly, facility clean, supplied with hand soa...
findings.comment: 750-1032 The handwashing sink at the bar was not clearly designated. Soap, papertoweling, and signage was made available during the inspection. ALSO, the womens toilet room has a sign indicating the door should be left open after use. Cease this behavior. Allow the door to close between and after uses.  All restrooms must have self-closing doors, properly operating fixtures, be clean and have proper hand washing supplies in order to help facilitate good hygienic practices.  Provide properly designed and maintained restrooms.

findings.title: Wiping cloths clean, used properly, stored
findings.comment: Observed wet wiping cloths stored on top of reach in cooler. Store wiping cloths in sanitizer solution between uses. Corrected immediately. 750-810

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment: Observed the floor below and around equipment at the bar to be soiled with an accumulation of dust and debris. Clean floors. 750-1220

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment: Floors shall be kept free of accumulated soil.  Observed the floor under coolers behind the bar to be soiled, or dusty.  Clean the floor in the above-referenced area.  750-1220
